summary: Checked against opened pages. In 2025 only 6.9% of new scooters sold in Taiwan were electric (Taipei 22.1%; other big cities about 5-7%), against a 20% target and the 2022 national plan of 35% by 2030, 70% by 2035 and 100% of new sales by 2040. No ban on petrol-scooter sales was found. Gogoro took about 87% of July 2026 electric registrations, so nearly every new electric scooter uses its swap network. KYMCO ended its unlimited-battery plan in June 2026. Swap-plan electric costs more per month than petrol for a 300 km/month rider (NT$569-679 vs about NT$450, public TV estimate). Grid power emitted 0.467 kg CO2e/kWh in 2025 (0.471 for homes); an expert estimate puts the CO2 break-even at about 6,284 km on the 2020 grid. Taipei fines scooters that skip required emissions inspection (NT$500-60,000) in air-quality zones; zones do not ban petrol scooters. Petrol-station totals, scooter-charger counts, Ionex site counts and island coverage remain unknown.

findings.sourcePublisher: 工商時報, relaying SMAT (台灣智慧移動產業協會) analysis of 公路局 data
findings.verifierNote: Opened via curl; every figure in valueText is on the page, including 'SMAT 16日公布' and 台南市及高雄市普及率亦僅5%. Minor conflict: a TVBS piece on the same SMAT report (cars.tvbs.com.tw/hot/341441) says the other five cities' 市售比 span 4.9%-6.9% (vs 4.8% for Kaohsiung here); cite city numbers to one source only. Primary 公路局 table still not seen.

findings.subject: Annual electric-scooter new registrations, 2025 and 2024
findings.valueText: 2025 全年 49,128輛 (1~12月累計, TVBS table); 2024 全年 78,757輛 (search summary only); 2023 79,584 (search summary only). Dec 2025 4,937 vs Dec 2024 5,118

The 貨物稅 passage says the Aug-29 amendment lets new 125cc-or-below petrol scooters get up to NT$2,000 tax cut which together with the existing NT$4,000 scrap subsidy is 'up to NT$6,000' (not just 2,000). 2024's 78,757 and 2023's 79,584 were only seen in a search-engine summary of other TVBS articles (SECONDARY, not opened). The 2015-2022 series and the gasoline series remain unfound.

findings.subject: Petrol station counts: no official national total found
findings.valueText: No official 能源署 national total. Company-level only: 山隆 71座; 全國加油站 (a company brand, not 'all of Taiwan') 111個據點. A search summary attributes '2,501 stations as of 2025-08' to NPC investor material, not opened.
findings.verifierNote: Opened the article: it says 山隆 has 71 stations; the '111' is the company 全國加油站's count (the researcher's wording 'national 111' risks being misread as a country total). 2,501 re-seen only as a search summary of an investor deck. moea.gov.tw returns 403. Value set to null; do not publish a national count or petrol-vs-swap comparison.

findings.subject: KYMCO Ionex swap-station count and network compatibility
findings.valueText: No current official figure. Old: 2021 500th Ionex 3.0 station, target 1,000; a later plan of 4,000 new-generation stations is a target not a count (search summary). No source found saying Ionex and Gogoro batteries are interchangeable.
findings.verifierNote: Original had value 0 as a placeholder; replaced with null to avoid being read as a count. Search results say KYMCO runs its own network and is not in Gogoro's PBGN alliance, but that is a search summary, not an opened source. Network compatibility: treat as separate networks until KYMCO or Gogoro say otherwise.

findings.subject: KYMCO unlimited-battery plan ended June 2026
findings.valueText: 2026年6月起光陽吃到飽專案結束; a delivery rider's monthly electricity cost rose to about NT$5,000+ at 3,500 km/month
findings.quote: 但2026年6月起，光陽吃到飽專案結束，陳錦弘估計一個月電費就暴增到5千多元
findings.verifierNote: Researcher said KYMCO 'raised fees' and 'cited financial pressure'. Page confirms the unlimited plan ended in June 2026 with an anecdotal rider cost rise; I found no 'financial pressure' statement by KYMCO on the page (only an unrelated rail-deficit line), so that claim is dropped. Also notes Gogoro ended its own unlimited plan in 2022 with legacy customers unaffected.

findings.subject: Monthly cost for a 300 km/month commuter, swap vs petrol (TV report)
findings.valueText: 電動 (Gogoro/KYMCO 資費+基本保養) 約 569-679 元/月; 燃油機車加油+保養約 450 元/月
findings.quote: 一般通勤族每個月騎乘300公里，加上基本保養，一個月大約花費569-679元，而燃油機車加油加上保養，大約花費450元。
findings.verifierNote: Opened; quote exact. The same sentence gives 2026 market share Gogoro 78%, KYMCO 8.9% (the researcher's note on 78% confirmed as stated, conflicts with 86.8-87% in monthly TVBS tallies, probably a different period/definition). Plan assumptions are not stated; this is a TV estimate, so reconcile with running-costs.json before use.

findings.subject: Air-quality maintenance zone (空維區) rules for scooters - Taipei
findings.valueText: 臺北市: 未完成定期檢驗的機車進入空維區, 罰 500元至6萬元; 出廠滿5年須每年排氣定檢 (逾期未檢500元, 不合格未修復1,500元, 逾6個月最高3,000元並可能註銷牌照); 第3期擴大 (新生南路至松江路一帶) 緩衝期2025-01-01至06-30, 2025-07-01 起開罰; 第4期 (南京東路、仁愛路、信義路) 2026-07-01 起取締 (風傳媒)

findings.subject: Lifecycle comparison, electric vs petrol scooter (Taiwan)
findings.valueText: 臺灣LCA學會理事長: 以2020年台灣能源組成模擬, 燃油機車累積CO2超過電動機車的轉折約6,284 km (以13.3 km/日、每週5天約1.8年); 環境部資料: 電動機車 25.2 g CO2/km vs 汽油機車 50.8 g/km; 七期機車: CO 約電動的111倍、NMHC 35倍、NOx 2.2倍; 2023政府統計 年能源費 電動 7,592 vs 燃油 5,710 元
findings.quote: 傳統燃油機車產生的二氧化碳排放量，在行駛距離為 6284 公里時，將超過電動機車。
findings.sourcePublisher: 風傳媒/天下生活, author the president of 臺灣生命週期評估學會
findings.verifierNote: Opened; all numbers present. The article does not give battery size, replacement, or PM2.5; the underlying study is not cited, so it is an expert's summary, not a reproducible LCA. The 25.2 vs 50.8 g/km figures are attributed to 環境部 without a link. NOx only 2.2x electric (tailpipe, 七期), per the article.
